messages.text: What documents do you need to recover my account? How long will the review take?
Please provide the transaction ID from your purchase receipt. Do not send your password or verification codes. After we verify the transaction ID, we will review your recovery request.
We received your transaction ID. We will complete the review of your recovery request within 3 business days. Your account has not been restored yet. We will email you after the review.
